held_out_settings_rules.nearest: the training section whose share of Currier-A folios is closest to the held-out section's share (folio metadata only, no text); ties -> the training section with more folios
held_out_settings_rules.pooled: one model fitted on all training text pooled (engine, pool and unit tilt from the union of the other sections)
held_out_settings_rules.random-section (null): a training section drawn uniformly at random per seed

topic_rule: held-out section's plaintext = the work of mech_hybrid_topics.TOPIC_WORK (fixed in the hybrid stage before this test); null: a random other work per seed
primary_comparison: SV P50 nearest (best no-plaintext accuracy variant of h06) vs A2 codebook topic-matched (the only topic hybrid that reached the section signal in step 2); secondary: all other rows
score: per (section, statistic): z = (generator mean - MS 408) / sqrt(SD_gen^2 (1 + 1/n) + SE_MS^2), SE_MS = delete-one-block jackknife over blocks of 3 consecutive held-out folios; family score = mean |z| (clipped at 10) over 5 sections x statistics, and number inside the 95 % prediction interval; paired Wilcoxon over (section, statistic) cells

C0g global copy-modify (baseline): one global engine, no section dependence
SV P50 nearest: per-section pool of 50 types; held-out = nearest section's settings
SV P50 pooled: held-out = pool fitted on all training text
SV U nearest: per-section unit tilt (all units); nearest rule
SV U pooled: unit tilt of all training text
SV EUP25 pooled: engine+units+pool 25 fitted on all training text
SV EUP25 random-section (null): held-out uses a random training section's EUP25 settings
A1 topic-matched: Naibbe-token hybrid; held-out encodes its topical Latin work
A2 topic-matched: whole-word codebook hybrid; held-out encodes its topical Latin work
A2 random-topic (null): codebook hybrid; held-out encodes a random other work
